verdict.rationale: Formant documents broad programmatic surfaces: APIs and SDKs to ingest data, configure devices, and design custom views and modules; an Admin API for creating custom commands; and Cloud SDK query and ingestion APIs. Nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a published OpenAPI or complete API reference, API coverage evidence for teleop/analytics dashboards/alerts/orchestration, independent hands-on corroboration.
